title: Smartsheet API: Rate Limits, Auth and Examples (2026)
summary: Smartsheet API authenticates with access tokens to read and write sheets, rows, and reports.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Access and plans


Whichever side of that split a job lands on, five questions about access and environment come up before anything ships. Each answer points to the Smartsheet developer docs at[developers.smartsheet.com](https://developers.smartsheet.com/) , which are the authority on current terms.


Is the Smartsheet API free to use?


Smartsheet doesn't bill per API call, but access is tied to your plan, not offered as a standalone product.


Confirm that your plan includes API access before you design around it, because a token generated on an account without it won't help you. The plan and access details are in the[developer docs](https://developers.smartsheet.com/) .


### Testing environments


Does Smartsheet have a sandbox or test environment?


Smartsheet documents a sandbox as part of certain plans, not as something every account gets. Without one, test against a dedicated sheet in a separate workspace so a faulty write can't touch production rows. Check the[developer docs](https://developers.smartsheet.com/) for whether your plan includes a sandbox.


Can I use the Smartsheet API on a free trial?


It depends on what the trial includes, and trial terms change.


Treat trial access as unconfirmed until you've generated a token and made a read call against a test sheet. If that call is rejected, the trial doesn't cover API use, and you shouldn't build a proof of concept on it.


The[developer docs](https://developers.smartsheet.com/) describe what access requires.


### Regions and webhooks


Which Smartsheet region base URL should I use?


Use the base URL for the region where your account is hosted. Smartsheet runs separate hosts for its regional and government environments, so a token issued in one region will fail against another region's host.


The symptom is authentication errors on a token you know is valid. Check the host list in the[developer docs](https://developers.smartsheet.com/) before you hard-code anything.


Does the Smartsheet API support webhooks?


Yes. Smartsheet webhooks send a callback to a URL you control when a sheet changes, so you can react to events instead of polling.


Your endpoint must complete the verification handshake before callbacks are enabled, so build that first. The setup is in the[developer docs](https://developers.smartsheet.com/) .
